CR explained

What is a Commercial Registration in Bahrain?

A Commercial Registration (CR) certificate is the legal document issued by the Ministry of Industry and Commerce (MOIC) through the online Sijilat portal when you register your business in the Kingdom of Bahrain. Every company needs one before it can open a bank account, sign a lease, sponsor visas or issue invoices.

Three types of CR certificate

  • 1

    CR without licence

    Issued first, before approvals or licences for your business activities are obtained.

  • 2

    CR with licence

    Issued once the required approvals and licences for your activities are in place.

  • 3

    Virtual CR (Sijili)

    Gives small individual enterprises and entrepreneurs legal status for selected activities, with simpler procedures.

What your CR certificate shows

  • CR number and establishment date
  • Name of the legal representative
  • Legal form of the establishment
  • Commercial (trade) name
  • Registration expiry date
  • Activity / business licence, once approved

Source: Bahrain National Portal (bahrain.bh). Keylink manages the full Commercial Registration process on Sijilat for you.

FAQ

Commercial registration Bahrain FAQs

Still unsure? Message us on WhatsApp and our advisors will help.

Typical reply within one business day

What is a Commercial Registration (CR) in Bahrain?

A CR is the official registration issued by the Ministry of Industry and Commerce (MOIC) through the Sijilat portal. It allows a company to legally carry out its registered activities in Bahrain.

Can foreigners own 100% of a Bahrain company?

Many activities allow full foreign ownership, but it depends on the specific activity and legal form. We check eligibility for your activity before you apply.

How long does CR registration take?

It varies by legal form, activity and approvals needed. Simple cases move faster; regulated activities need extra approvals. We give you a case-specific estimate.

Do I need an office address?

Most CRs require a registered commercial address. We advise on suitable premises options for your activity.

How much does a CR cost?

Government fees depend on the legal form, your activities and any special approvals required. We give you a written cost breakdown covering all fees before anything is filed.

Can I register from outside Bahrain?

In many cases, yes. With a properly prepared power of attorney we can manage name reservation and filings on your behalf. We confirm what is possible for your situation before you commit.

What happens after the CR is issued?

Your CR must be kept active through annual renewals, and you will typically need a registered address, municipal registration and — if you hire staff — LMRA approvals. We guide you through each step.

Do you help after registration?

Yes. We support corporate bank accounts, work permits and residence, CR renewals, activity changes and address updates — so your company stays compliant as it grows.

Do I need a Bahraini partner?

For most activities, no. Bahrain allows 100% foreign ownership for the majority of commercial activities. We confirm the requirement for your specific activity and legal form before you apply.

What documents do I need to start?

For most structures: passports of all shareholders, your proposed company name, the activities you plan to carry out and proof of address. We send you a personalised checklist before anything is filed.

Can I change or add activities later?

Yes. Activities can be added, removed or amended on your CR through the Sijilat portal. Some activities require additional approvals, which we handle for you.

What legal forms can I choose from?

The most common are the W.L.L, the Single Person Company, a branch of a foreign company and the individual establishment. We recommend the right form based on your ownership, activity and growth plans.
